name: Divine Shield
description: Protects the paladin from all damage and spells for 12 sec, but increases the time between your attacks by 100%.  Once protected, the target cannot be made invulnerable by Divine Shield, Divine Protection, Blessing of Protection again or use Avenging Wrath for 1 min.
buff_text: Immune to all attacks and spells, but increases the time between your attacks by 100%.
